cards.audioText: [You are at Wuhan airport, before departure, you received the cabin report said there is ice build-up on the wing, you want to make a de-icing procedure, report to ground controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在武汉机场，离场前，你收到一个客舱报告，称机翼上有积冰，你希望执行除冰程序，报告给地面管制员]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL403, request de-icing procedure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，美联航403，请求除冰程序。

cards.audioText:
UAL403, Wuhan Ground, where do you want to de-ice?
[Tell ground you want to de-ice on taxiway Z4.]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航403，武汉地面，你想在哪里除冰？
[告诉管制员，你希望在滑行道Z4除冰]
[告知地面，除冰程序完成，请求滑行]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL403, de-icing completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，美联航403，除冰程序完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: UAL403, Ground, taxi to holding point runway 36R via Z4, A3, and A.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航403，通过滑行道Z4，A3和A，到跑道36右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via Z4, A3, A, UAL403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过滑行道Z4，A3和A，到跑道36右等待点，美联航403。

cards.audioText: [You notice ice contaminated on taxiways, and your de-icing fluid can only be effective for 30 minutes, tell Ground you need to make an intersection departure from Z4 before 0835Z.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你发现积冰污染了滑行道，你的除冰液有有效期仅为30分钟，告诉管制员，你需要在08：35Z前，从滑行道Z4进行减跑道起飞]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL403, request Z4 intersection departure before 0835Z due de-icing fluid is effective for 30min.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，美联航403，由于除冰液有效期仅为30分钟，请求在08：35Z前，从滑行道Z4进行减跑道起飞。

cards.audioText: UAL403, intersection departure before 0835Z is approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航403，可以在08:35Z前减跑道起飞。
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以在08:35Z前减跑道起飞，美联航403。

cards.audioText: [Now you are cruising at 10200m, and encountering moderate turbulence. Ask control for a higher level.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在10200米巡航，遭遇了中度颠簸，报告管制员，申请更高高度]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL403, request climbing due moderate turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航403，由于中度颠簸，请求爬升。

cards.audioText:
UAL403, 10700m and 11200m are both available, which do you prefer?
[Tell controller you prefer 10,700m.]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航403,10700米和11200米都可用，你选哪一个？
[告诉管制员你想选10700米]

cards.audioText:
UAL403, radar shows your aircraft is a little higher than your assigned level, please check your altitude.
[Because of turbulence, you want to climb to 11300m to avoid it. Ask Wuhan Control if any turbulence was reported at that level by preceding aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航403，雷达显示你的飞机比指定的高度层稍高，请检查你的高度。
[由于颠簸，你想爬升至11300米避开颠簸，询问武汉区调，在此高度上，前机是否有颠簸的报告]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL403, confirm if there is any turbulence report at 11300m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航403，证实11300米上是否有颠簸报。

cards.audioText:
UAL403, there is no turbulence report at 11300m.
[Tell controller you want to climb to 11300m due turbulence.]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航403,11300米上没有颠簸报。
[告诉武汉区调，由于颠簸，你想爬升至11300米]
cards.referenceText: Request climb to 11300m due turbulence, UAL403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求爬升至11300米避开颠簸，美联航403。

cards.audioText: UAL403, climb and maintain 11300m. Contact Guangzhou Control on 119.75.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航403，爬升至11300米保持，联系广州区调119.75。

cards.audioText: [Contact Guangzhou control and request descent to 4500m.]
cards.audioTextZh: [联系广州区调，请求下降至4500米]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL403, request descent to 4500m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，美联航403，请求下降至4500米。

cards.audioText: UAL403, Guangzhou Control, descend to 4500m. Reach 4500m 10 miles before ATAGA, descend at own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航403，广州区调，下降至4500米。在ATAGA 10海里前下降到4500米。自行决定下降。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4500m, reach 4500m 10 miles before ATAGA, descend at own discretion, UAL403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到4500米，在ATAGA 10海里前下降到4500米。自行决定下降，美联航403。

cards.audioText: [You encountered some turbulence again, tell Guangzhou Control you want to deviate 10 miles to the right to avoid it.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你又一次遇到了颠簸，告诉广州区调，你想右偏10海里来避开颠簸]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL403, request deviate 10 miles to the right to avoid turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，美联航403，请求右偏10海里来避开颠簸。

cards.audioText: UAL403, deviate 10 miles to the right approved, then track direct to TAN, contact approach 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航403，可以右偏10海里，直飞TAN，联系进近118.5。
cards.referenceText: Deviate 10 miles to the right, track direct to TAN, 118.5, UAL403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右偏航10海里，直飞TAN，118.5，美联航403。
